title: Check: Planning the Site and Space

questions.prompt: Why is physical planning so important to get right early?
options: Physical mistakes are the most expensive to fix later
Physical planning is required by the OSI model

questions.prompt: Which is a real-estate question to ask about a site?
options: Whether it's exposed to floods, earthquakes, or other disasters nearby
What the Wi-Fi password should be

questions.prompt: What's the four-letter abbreviation for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning?
Standard metal frames that servers and switches bolt into are called ______. (one word)
The small room on each floor where that floor's cables meet a switch is called the wiring ______. (one word)
Why does the 100 m limit matter when planning wiring closets?
options: It doesn't, cables can be any length
It's the maximum height of a building
Every desk's twisted-pair run has to reach the closet within the segment limit

questions.prompt: Most sites are a hybrid: wired for desks and servers, wireless for laptops and phones.
What's the main trade-off of keeping servers on-site instead of in a remote data center?
options: On-site means more control but more responsibility
Remote servers can't be reached over a network
